editorial: While the software world focuses on cleaning up forty years of technical debt, developers like NVIDIA and Moonshot AI are expanding infrastructure capacity with next-generation artificial intelligence models. Security vulnerabilities in communication networks and new approaches in video understanding models are at the center of technical discussions today.

items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
items.summary: Auto-ontology, developed by NVIDIA, is a Python framework that enables the creation of semantic and graph-based reasoning layers on data. This tool offers more explainable results and deterministic query generation for large language models (LLM) and AI agent workflows.

snapshot.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.

items.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, worktrunk is a command-line interface (CLI) that simplifies Git worktree management. The tool is specifically designed to manage the simultaneous workflows of multiple AI agents.

snapshot.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows. Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: Shared by Matt Pocock, mattpocock/skills is a collection containing AI agent skills used in real engineering processes. Prepared to automate software development tasks, this resource focuses on tools that can be applied directly to daily workflows rather than theoretical approaches.

snapshot.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory. My agent skills that I use every day to do real engineering - not vibe coding.

items.title: floci-io/floci
items.summary: Developed with Java, floci is an open-source local AWS emulator used for software development, testing processes, and continuous integration (CI) operations. It offers developers a free alternative by mimicking cloud services in a local environment.

snapshot.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative. Floci is a free, open-source local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.summary: thedotmack/claude-mem is a tool that provides persistent context across sessions for AI agents. It compresses session data with AI to make relevant information available for future operations and works compatibly with various development tools such as Claude Code.

snapshot.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

items.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
items.summary: Developed by Vercel Labs, agent-desktop is a command-line interface (CLI) that allows AI agents to see and manage desktop applications on macOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems. Written in Rust, this tool uses the operating system's accessibility tree to enable agents to perform operations on the computer.

snapshot.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents. Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

items.title: github/spec-kit
items.summary: Developed by GitHub, spec-kit is an open-source toolkit that provides structured processes, reusable templates, and documented outputs to AI coding agents. Aiming to standardize software development processes, this kit allows for the customization of ready-made processes or the integration of users' own processes.

snapshot.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!. Spec Kit is an open source toolkit that gives AI coding agents structured processes, reusable templates, and documented outcomes. Start with a ready-made process, customize it, or bring your own.

items.title: The-PR-Agent/pr-agent
items.summary: The-PR-Agent/pr-agent is an open-source project designed to review pull requests in software development processes. Developed in Python, this tool aims to automate code review tasks.

snapshot.description: 🚀 PR Agent: The Original Open-Source PR Reviewer. This project is not the Qodo free tier. This repository contains the open-source PR Agent Project. It is not the Qodo offering for open-source projects.

items.title: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
items.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo is a Python project that creates high-resolution short videos from entered topics or keywords using AI models and automated workflows. The project utilizes Kimi K3.1 Pro, a large language model developed by Moonshot AI, to manage processes such as writing video scripts and selecting visual materials.

snapshot.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow. 感谢 Kimi 赞助本项目！Kimi K3.1 Pro 是 Moonshot AI 迄今能力最强的 3T 级开放权重模型，拥有原生视觉能力与 100 万 Token 上下文，在知识工作、推理和长周期任务中展现前沿性能。在 MoneyPrinterTurbo 中，K3.1 Pro 能直接驱动视频创作，不仅撰写视频文案，还会提炼素材搜索关键词、决定成片画面；对内容理解越准确，匹配到的素材就越贴题。

items.title: garrytan/gstack
items.summary: Shared by Garry Tan, gstack offers 23 different toolsets structured on Claude Code to manage software development processes. These tools aim to automate workflows by assuming the responsibilities of various roles such as CEO, designer, engineering manager, and quality assurance expert.

snapshot.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

items.title: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
items.summary: The FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c project enables the 2.78 trillion parameter Kimi K3 model to be run on a single processor with 8.24 GB of memory usage. This C99-based application, which does not require any framework or graphics processing unit (GPU), focuses on running high-parameter AI models on limited hardware.

snapshot.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.

items.title: JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio
items.summary: Disc Image Studio is a cross-platform disc image creation and burning tool that allows you to etch naked-eye visible images onto DVDs, CDs, and single-layer Blu-ray discs. Developed in C#, this software enables you to process custom graphics onto the disc surface using any writable optical drive.

snapshot.description: Disc Image Studio 是一个多平台的光盘盘面图像生成与刻录工具，帮助您使用任何刻录光驱在任何 DVD / CD / 单层蓝光 光盘上刻蚀出肉眼可见的图像。

items.title: MichaelCade/90DaysOfDevOps
items.summary: MichaelCade/90DaysOfDevOps offers a structured learning map on DevOps processes, principles, and tools. Covering three years of content, this resource serves as a comprehensive training guide for community members.

snapshot.description: This repository started out as a learning in public project for myself and has now become a structured learning map for many in the community. We have 3 years under our belt covering all things DevOps, including Principles, Processes, Tooling and Use Cases surrounding this vast topic.

items.title: D4Vinci/Scrapling
items.summary: Scrapling is a Python-based web scraping framework capable of managing all stages from simple data extraction to comprehensive crawling processes. It provides all the tools users need in a single structure, from a single request to large-scale data collection processes.

snapshot.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev

items.title: Thysrael/Horizon
items.summary: Thysrael/Horizon is a news tracking tool that collects, filters, and summarizes news from different sources using artificial intelligence. Preparing daily newsletters in English and Chinese, this software helps users manage their information flow by presenting content along with context and community discussions.

snapshot.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达. Good reads are scattered across feeds, forums, and timelines. Your attention isn't unlimited. Horizon collects, filters, and deduplicates them, then brings the worthwhile ones to you with context and community discussion.

items.title: scenario-labs/skills
items.summary: scenario-labs/skills is a library that enables AI agents to select the right model and control costs for the production of visual, auditory, and 3D content. The tool uses the Scenario MCP protocol to maintain character consistency while integrating with professional design software such as Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.

snapshot.description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.

items.title: AI is forcing us to pay off 40 years of technical debt
items.summary: The use of artificial intelligence in the field of cybersecurity is increasing the speed of both attackers and defenders, bringing technical debt in fragile legacy systems to light. This situation is triggering a process that forces institutions to renew forty-year-old software infrastructures.

snapshot.description: AI in cybersecurity accelerates both attackers and defenders, revealing painful technical debt in fragile legacy systems.

items.title: Residential proxies detected on White House network
items.summary: It is reported that residential proxies have been detected on the White House network. This situation opens up a discussion on the security implications of these networks, which route internet traffic through corporate networks and generally provide anonymity.

items.title: AMD expects to outsell Intel in Q4 for the first time in history
items.summary: AMD projects that its processor sales will surpass Intel's for the first time in the fourth quarter. The company's announced revenue expectation of $17 billion exceeds the projections shared by its rival Intel for the same period.

items.title: Guerrilla bike lanes: San Francisco makes illicit infrastructure permanent (2016)
items.summary: Illegal bike lanes created by anonymous activists with traffic cones in San Francisco have been turned into permanent infrastructure by the city administration. This intervention was carried out to raise awareness for safe transportation following the deaths of cyclists in traffic accidents.

snapshot.description: When two cyclists were tragically killed in hit-and-run collisions this past summer, a group of anonymous urban activists known as the San Francisco Transformation Agency erected a set of protected bike lanes using traffic cones. Usually such guerrilla interventions are temporary. They raise awareness but ultimately get taken down by municipal authorities.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text inputs. Trained on top of the Kimi K3 model with large-scale reinforcement learning, this model is presented as the first and most capable version of the K3.1 series.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, and our most capable 3T-class model to date. Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series.

items.title: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B is an open-weight automatic speech recognition model capable of transcribing in 40 languages. Supporting audio recordings of up to one hour, the model operates with a mixture-of-experts architecture.

snapshot.description: automatic-speech-recognition model. Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, offline speech and audio model for transcription in 40 languages, with support for recordings up to one hour and a 65,536-token context. Its hybrid mixture-of-experts architecture activates approximately 4.3B parameters, including the audio encoder, and it is released in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 precision.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is an image-to-text model capable of processing visual and text-based inputs. As an updated version of the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model, it aims to reduce processing time and costs while providing performance improvements in areas such as reasoning and coding.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: speridlabs/idol
items.summary: speridlabs/idol is an AI model that creates 3D Gaussian splat models of objects from a single photo. This tool, which cleans the background and outputs in the standard 3DGS .ply format, can run on consumer-grade graphics processors in under two seconds.

snapshot.description: image-to-3d model. Idol turns one picture of an object into a 3D Gaussian splat. Give it a render, a generated image or a photo: it removes the background, frames the object and generates up to 1,048,576 Gaussians, written as a standard 3DGS .ply. It runs on consumer GPUs, using 7.2 GB of VRAM and can run in under 2 seconds.

items.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B
items.summary: LFM3-1.7B, developed by LiquidAI, is a text-generation model designed for local agents and specialized applications. Built on a new tri-hybrid architecture, this model is optimized to run on systems with low resource requirements.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on our new tri-hybrid architecture.

items.title: VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation
items.summary: VA-TDM is a method developed to improve image quality in few-step diffusion models. By using velocity adversarial distillation, it aims to overcome distribution matching challenges in the sampling process.

snapshot.description: Few-step distillation offers efficient generation with diffusion and flow models, but preserving quality with only a few sampling steps remains challenging. Distribution-matching methods via score distillation provide a strong foundation, yet they rely on accurately tracking the student's changing distribution. At intermediate generation steps in few-step sampling, student-score estimation can be difficult, and commonly used estimators may describe a different distribution from the one used to u

items.title: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
items.summary: SleuthVLM, shared by Hugging Face, questions whether multimodal AI models (omni models) actually need direct audio data for video understanding processes. Processing conversations by converting them to text, this system interprets video content through a Vision Language Model (VLM) that analyzes visual data independently.

snapshot.description: Omni models answer questions about videos by jointly processing sampled frames and audio in one turn, with progress driven largely by scaling model size and omni training data. We ask whether a model needs to hear the audio directly at all, and present SleuthVLM, an agent harness built on a VLM that never hears the audio directly: speech will be transcribed into text, and the VLM will sleuth the video on its own without any predefined workflow. items.title: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
items.summary: AnchorComplete offers a framework that generates complete scene meshes from partial point clouds. Developed based on TRELLIS.2, this method allows for the completion of scenes at different scales while preserving the observed geometry.

snapshot.description: Most image-based 3D reconstructors primarily recover visible surfaces, producing partial point clouds with large holes and leaving unobserved geometry unresolved. To address this limitation, we introduce AnchorComplete, a framework that reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds while preserving observed geometry and supporting scenes of varying scales. items.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: NEO-VLA, shared by Hugging Face, offers a method that allows visual data to be transferred directly to action policies without compression. This approach aims for more precise processing of visual details such as local geometry and depth, which are critical in robotic manipulation processes.

snapshot.description: Vision-language-action models are typically built on a simple premise: perception is first compressed by visual encoders, and action reasoning begins only afterwards. Yet manipulation often hinges on precisely the visual signals most vulnerable to this abstraction, e.g., local geometry, boundaries, depth, and subtle state changes. items.title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
items.summary: StreamDuo is an AI model that can provide live commentary for previously unseen games and is paired with a research agent that reads the game's online encyclopedia (wiki). This system was developed to address the lack of knowledge about game worlds in existing Large Language Models (LLMs).

snapshot.description: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world. The process that allows software changes to be automatically tested and merged into the main project.

A foundational structure that provides ready-made components and rules to simplify software development.
A powerful processing unit used in computers, especially for graphics rendering and artificial intelligence calculations.
The process of automatically collecting and saving data from websites.
The phenomenon where temporary solutions implemented for quick fixes in software development require additional work in the future.
Servers that appear as real home internet connections and are used to mask internet traffic.
